character: The West Spur Dig is an archaeologists' camp at the end of the Rift's west spur, and half its Pokemon dig, haul and record; the others are what the dig turned up. An outpost by its own plan ("An outpost, so no Center") and a camp by the scale; no pets, because the camp places no archaeologist or keeper for one to belong to.

workers.interact: The Diggersby takes the excavation's face back a hand's width at a time with its ears. It stops dead whenever its ears touch something hard.
The Timburr carries planks up the track for the scaffold over the cut. It carries them the way it carries its own beam: over one shoulder, without looking.
The Smeargle draws every find on the finds shed's tally board before it goes in. Its drawings are better than the photographs.

placed.why: on the finds shed's roof under the spur's overhang, where it is darkest at noon

situations.title: The Unown at the cut face
situations.story: Two Unown hang in front of the excavation's cut where it has exposed carving. The archaeologists have started copying down the shapes they make.
situations.why: the dig's own: at the cut's east edge, floating, where a player looking at the excavation sees them
